title: ACME Burning Rate Emulator
summary: Porous burners emulate condensed-material burning under quiescent reduced-gravity conditions.
objective: Compare burning and extinction behavior across fuel feeds and oxygen/nitrogen conditions.

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
summary: Examines ignition, growth, spread, and extinction of solid fuels in low-speed forced flow.
objective: Relate solid-fuel behavior to oxygen, flow, fuel properties, sample geometry, and screening tests.
fuelsAndMaterials: Solid fuels; specific samples require record-level review

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
summary: Studies solid-fuel flame spread and inert-gas suppression across geometry, preheating, and flow.
objective: Understand how flame geometry and suppressant delivery interact in reduced gravity.
fuelsAndMaterials: Solid fuels; specific samples require record-level review

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment I
summary: Large-scale fire-growth investigation comparing reduced-gravity flammability with a normal-gravity screening test.
objective: Characterize large-scale fire growth and low-gravity material flammability.
fuelsAndMaterials: Material samples; run-specific details not verified here

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment II
summary: Distinct SAFFIRE investigation record focused on large-scale fire growth and material flammability.
objective: Compare reduced-gravity fire growth and material flammability with normal-gravity screening.
fuelsAndMaterials: Material samples; run-specific details not verified here

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment III
summary: Third distinct SAFFIRE investigation record for large-scale fire growth and low-gravity flammability.
objective: Compare reduced-gravity fire growth and material flammability with normal-gravity screening.
fuelsAndMaterials: Material samples; run-specific details not verified here

title: Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiments
summary: Studies diffusion-flame structure, stabilization, liftoff, dilution, soot, and radiative heat loss.
objective: Characterize laminar flames and provide data for combustion-model validation.
fuelsAndMaterials: Multiple gaseous fuels; consult the investigation record for specific runs

title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test
summary: Tests particle-counter performance in microgravity and compares measurements with a control instrument.
objective: Assess aerosol measurement feasibility and support discrimination of combustion particles from dust.

title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment
summary: Measures smoke-particle size distributions for spacecraft materials under varied test conditions.
objective: Relate sample temperature, airflow, and smoke residence time to particle signatures and detector needs.
fuelsAndMaterials: Spacecraft materials; specific samples require record-level review

title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment - Research
summary: Extends SAME with modified materials, conditions, and diagnostics; file descriptions include flight and microscopy assets.
objective: Characterize smoke aerosols while preserving run, sample, and diagnostic provenance.
fuelsAndMaterials: Spacecraft materials; specific samples require record-level review

title: SAME-Data Smoke Modeling
summary: Ground-based particle-growth modeling considers cross-flow, thermophoresis, settling, and wake geometry.
objective: Simulate dibutyl-phthalate particle growth under Earth and microgravity conditions.

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
summary: Studies liquid-droplet flammability limits, burning, and gaseous-suppressant behavior.
objective: Measure burning, extinction, radiation, soot, and temperature for droplet combustion.
fuelsAndMaterials: Nitrogen, carbon dioxide, helium, or xenon diluents

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment II
summary: Extends droplet-combustion work to bi-component fuels, extinction boundaries, soot-shell dynamics, and droplet interactions.
objective: Study gas- and liquid-phase behavior and validate combustion models across droplet regimes.
fuelsAndMaterials: Bi-component liquid fuels; specific blends require record-level review

title: Cool Flames Investigation
summary: Examines low-temperature droplet combustion, extinction, and soot behavior across pressure and dilution conditions.
objective: Study n-dodecane and n-dodecane/isododecane cool flames from 0.25 to 5 atm.

title: FLEX Cool-Flame CFD
summary: Ground-based OpenFOAM follow-on modeling of n-alkane droplet cool flames against FLEX observations.
objective: Analyze ignition delay, oscillation, flame stand-off, and extinction under modeled conditions.

title: FLEX-Based Cool-Flame Study
summary: Secondary analysis combining simulations and ground counterflow-flame experiments using FLEX context.
objective: Examine cool-flame transitions and extinction.

title: ACME Flame Design
summary: Studies normal and inverse spherical diffusion flames across fuel, flow, dilution, and pressure conditions.
objective: Investigate soot inception and extinction behavior.

title: ACME Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
summary: Characterizes methane and ethylene coflow flames from near-extinction to highly sooting conditions.
objective: Relate fuel dilution and flow to flame and soot structure for model development.

title: ACME E-FIELD Flames
summary: Varies electric-field strength and polarity, fuel, and flow to study flame response, stability, and soot.
objective: Measure chemi-ion current and flame behavior in electric fields.

title: ACME Spherical Diffusion Flame
summary: Compares soot-free and sooty spherical-flame structure, dynamics, extinction, and model behavior.
objective: Provide flame-structure and transport/chemical-kinetic model validation evidence.

title: Smoke Points in Coflow Experiment
summary: Studies non-buoyant jet-flame smoke points and sooting propensity across fuels and flow conditions.
objective: Relate soot formation to fuel mixtures, burner size, coflow, and fuel/air flow.

title: ACME Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
summary: Studies gaseous cool diffusion flames in normal and inverse configurations with CFD support.
objective: Measure cool-flame behavior across fuel mixtures and flow conditions.

title: SPICE Image and Model Analysis
summary: Uses image processing and calibrated SPICE light data to estimate soot-temperature fields.
objective: Analyze soot differences between 1-g and 0-g flames.

title: BASS Flame-Spread Modeling
summary: Develops and validates flamelet-generated-manifold methods against BASS and tomography evidence.
objective: Model concurrent flame spread while separating simulation output from source measurements.
fuelsAndMaterials: Solid fuels; specific samples require record-level review

title: Surface Tension Driven Convection Experiment 1
summary: Studies thermocapillary flow and temperature fields in constant-temperature and constant-flux configurations.
objective: Investigate surface-tension-driven convection; not a direct fire-safety experiment.

title: Solder Structure and Properties
summary: Examines solder microstructure across terrestrial and microgravity settings and temperature conditions.
objective: Study Pb-Sn and lead-free solder properties; not a combustion investigation.
